
```{r}

# install.packages("bio3d")
library(bio3d)
# INPUTS:The PDB ID assigned to the proteins
# WHAT THIS FUNCTION DOES AND HOW TO USE IT: Reads each PDB structure, trims it to chain A and CA, extracts B-factors, and makes an overlay plot comparing all structures.
# OUTPUT: Gives a plot of the B-factor of a protein along the chain A using the CA atoms.
protein_analysis <- function(pdb_id) {
 # Access the protein structure
pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_id)

#Trim the protein to Chain A and CA atoms
pdb_chain <- trim.pdb(pdb, chain = "A", elety = "CA")

#Extract B-factor
pdb.b <- pdb_chain$atom$b

#Plot B-factor
plotb3(pdb.b, sse = pdb_chain, typ = "l", ylab = "Bfactor")

}
```
```{r}
protein_analysis("1AKE")
```
